About the job

TYTAN Technologies




The PACE is fast. The expectations are high. The contribution matters. Working at TYTAN is more than a job, this is a mission. We thrive, think big, and hold ourselves to the highest standard. At TYTAN, we aim to set a global standard in autonomous air defense with AI-driven, cost-efficient systems that counter unmanned aerial threats at scale. We protect people. We protect critical infrastructure. We protect Europe’s sovereignty.




We are looking for a new team member who is eager to make a real difference! As a Senior Backend Engineer, you will be responsible for designing and developing scalable military ground control station applications coordinating various effectors and integrating with external systems in real-time mission-critical environments.




Your roadmap to make an impact




Own the backend and integration layer for ground systems the services connecting operator tools, vehicles, sensors, and mission infrastructure
Design event-driven architectures and durable interface contracts so frontend, embedded, and partner systems can integrate and evolve safely
Build software that holds up in real operations, from telemetry pipelines to deployment, and follow problems across service boundaries end to end (including occasional lab or field support)
Raise engineering standards through design, code review, and mentoring, working closely with frontend, embedded, and guidance/navigation/control engineers




Job requirements

Technical skills




Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience, plus 5+ years of commercial backend/platform development (no mission-domain background required)

Practical understanding of latency and performance trade-offs in system design

Hands-on observability skills: structured logging, metrics, and production experience with Prometheus/Grafana




Soft Skills




Comfortable working in Scrum or similar agile teams
Strong software craftsmanship: testing, debugging distributed issues, code review, and clear communication in English (German a plus)
Ownership mindset, you follow problems across service boundaries and take responsibility for making integrations work end to end




Nice to Have




ROS 2 experience (nodes, topics, services) and familiarity with DDS/QoS
Deeper networking knowledge (TCP/IP, UDP, sockets) or hands-on work with Nginx/HAProxy
Time-series databases (e.g. InfluxDB) for high-frequency telemetry
Additional languages such as TypeScript/Node, Go, or C++
Familiarity with MAVLink or similar vehicle/telemetry protocols
Prior work in robotics, autonomous systems, defense, or industrial control software
Tech-lead or mentoring experience
Willingness to travel occasionally for on-site integration and test campaigns




Why TYTAN?




Build technology with real operational impact: Develop autonomous defense systems designed to protect lives and strengthen Europe’s security
Shape scalable defense capabilities: Work on solutions built for mass deployment, cost efficiency, resilience, and reliable production at scale
Contribute to networked air defense: Help integrate our systems into multi-layered defense architectures alongside sensors, command systems, and effectors
Develop for real-world operations: Build capabilities together with end users and improve them continuously based on direct operational feedback
Move fast and take ownership: Work in a focused, high-performance team where decisions are made quickly and individual contributions have immediate impact
Define a new generation of defense technology: Join early and help shape the products, engineering standards, culture, and direction of a fast-growing deep-tech company
Work with an international mission-driven team: Collaborate with experienced specialists united by the goal of creating sovereign and effective security capabilities for Europe




Our Benefits




Virtual stock options: Participate in our success through Virtual stock options (VSOPs) at the company's current valuation
Monthly allowances: €106/month in flexible benefits including lunch discounts and EGYM Wellpass or shopping credit
Regular health care events: Health check-ups, skin screenings, mental health workshops, and an annual vitamin infusion on us
Referral bonus: Earn a reward when someone you refer joins the team
Regular team events: On- and off-site activities to connect and celebrate together
Corporate discounts: Exclusive employee discounts across a wide range of partner brands
Flexibility: Flexible working hours and hybrid work model, plus a modern Munich office built for focus and collaboration




About us




At TYTAN, it is more than just a job; it is about embracing autonomy, personal growth, and purpose. Make a lasting impact in the new era of defense! Join us to create a safer world for all.

WE are an equal-opportunity employer committed to fairness and inclusivity. We do not prioritize any specific religion, gender, nationality, or background. Due to security clearance requirements, affiliations with countries listed under § 13 para. 1 no. 17 SÜG may affect the application process.

job.title: Senior Frontend Engineer
job.description:
About the job

About MUBI

MUBI is a global streaming service, production company and film distributor dedicated to elevating great cinema. To make this possible, we create, curate, acquire and champion visionary films, bringing them to audiences all over the world. We have a team of brilliant, dedicated and passionate people to help bring our mission to life. From London to New York, Istanbul to Paris, and Berlin to Mexico - we work together to realize MUBI’s vision.

That’s where you come in! Join our global team and help us make great cinema accessible to everyone, everywhere.

About The Role

MUBI's web platform is where millions of people discover, read about and watch films. It's a streaming player, a curated catalogue and an editorial publication in one, and it has to feel fast and considered in every one of the countries we operate in.

We are seeking a Senior Engineer to join our Frontend team. In this role, you will contribute to the architecture and implementation of MUBI’s website, serving millions of cinema enthusiasts across the globe. This is a hands-on, senior individual contributor role reporting to our Head of Frontend.

You will partner closely with product managers, UX/UI designers, video CDN engineers, and backend teams to craft high-performance, seamless digital experiences - from our curated discovery channels to streaming platform capabilities and original editorial publications.

We work hybrid-remote where we require 3 in-office days if you're near one of our sites. Our core days are Tuesday, Wednesday & Thursday, with the flexibility to use our offices on the remaining two days if you wish.

Where you’ll have impact:


Build the web experience. Design and implement features across the platform, from discovery and catalogue to the player and our editorial pages, in React, TypeScript and Next.js. You'll own them end to end: technical scoping, implementation, automated testing (unit, integration, E2E), deployment and observability. 
Make playback feel effortless. Work directly on media player integrations, adaptive streaming experiences, dynamic video previews, and high-framerate media components. 
Keep it fast. Analyze and continuously optimize client-side bundle size, Core Web Vitals, server-side rendering performance, and edge caching strategies. 
Raise the bar. Set the standard for code quality, testing and review on the team, and help other engineers get there. 
Use AI where it pays off. Experiment with coding agents, share the prompts and skills that work, and push for measurable gains over novelty. 


What you’ll bring:


8+ Years of Frontend Experience. Proven track record building and operating complex, consumer-facing web applications at scale using React, Next.js/SSR, and TypeScript. 
Expert knowledge of the DOM, browser rendering optimization, web performance profiling tools, state management strategies, and HTTP/media protocol fundamentals. 
Understanding of how the media is delivered to and played in modern web browsers. Familiarity with the features and problems of technologies like HLS, DASH, Widevine, FairPlay, CORS. 
Championing AI adoption across the team - experimenting with coding agents, sharing reusable prompts/skills, and pushing for measurable gains rather than novelty. 
Committed to maintainable code, test-driven development (Jest, React Testing Library, Cypress/Playwright), and strong CI/CD practices. 
Clear and articulate technical communication in an agile, cross-functional engineering organization. We use Slack & Linear. 
An independent mindset and genuine curiosity about how the product is used - you generate your own questions rather than waiting for a brief. 


Nice to have:


Experience in a fast-paced, high-growth environment (e.g. startup or scale-up). 
Experience leading or contributing to cross-functional projects with teams such as Product, Marketing, Finance, or Engineering. 
Experience with design systems and close collaboration with designers. 
Genuine interest in film and in MUBI's mission. 


We want to make cinema accessible to everyone. We believe people from different backgrounds bring different ideas that foster innovation and engagement, allowing us to attract great people to develop the best experience for our users.

MUBI is committed to being an Equal Opportunity Employer. That means it's our responsibility to ensure that all candidates are not discriminated against in our hiring processes and our employment decisions based on their race, color, religion, nationality or ethnic origin, age, gender identity or expression, sex, marital status, physical or mental disability, socioeconomic background, sexual orientation, family or parental status, or any other applicable characteristic.

job.description:
About the job

About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $11B - multiples of 11, always.

We Have Expanded From Voice Into Three Main Platforms


ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.
ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.
ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.


Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work


High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.
Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.
AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.
Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.
Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.


What we offer


Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.
Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.
Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.
Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.
Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.
Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.


About The Role

We are looking for Full-Stack engineers to develop and maintain both front-end and back-end components of our product suite.

Your General Responsibilities Will Include


Building and maintaining the front-ends for our platform and products, which are built on top of our cutting-edge voice models and used by millions of users.
High degrees of ownership. You will be responsible for shipping end-to-end features across the front and back ends of our stack, as well as helping set the direction of the features and products you're working on.
Collaborating closely with others on the Engineering, Growth and Sales teams to understand, and design solutions for, our customer and internal team’s most important problems and workflows.


We believe in pairing engineers with work that matches their strengths and interests. This means that there is significant flexibility in staffing engineers across the company.

Specific Responsibilities Might Include


Improving our existing products to ensure that they’re intuitive, powerful and make innovative use of our research team’s latest break-throughs. This could involve making sweeping UX changes, adding significant functionality, or building integrations with other common consumer/enterprise solutions.
Designing & developing clean, intuitive, and functional user interfaces for products that will be used by millions of users and the world’s largest enterprises.
Working with internal teams and customers directly to synthesize feedback, understand user’s issues, and then design improvements and features to solve them.


Requirements

We do not require any formal experience, certifications, or degrees. Instead, we are seeking enthusiastic software engineers who can showcase solving impressively hard problems with artifacts such as past projects, designs, or GitHub contributions. We do require:


Experience with Web Development using Typescript/React
Familiarity with common software and system design patterns and infrastructure including APIs, cloud infrastructure tools, storage solutions, data structures etc.
Interest in UI/UX design


Location

This role is remote and can be executed globally. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, San Francisco, and Warsaw.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

About the job

Job Description

 Who We Are 

Spread Group is a renowned global provider of customized apparel and lifestyle products, distinguished by our commitment to made-to-order technology. Our core business model revolves around producing precisely what our customers desire, precisely when they desire it. As pioneers in this space, we combine sustainability with on-demand personalization, enabling individuals and businesses to express their unique identities through bespoke creations. Join us to be part of a global leader in the exciting world of personalized apparel and lifestyle products!

As we continue to expand our business, we are seeking a curious and passionate individual to join our team as of January 2027, as  Fullstack Engineer (f/m/d)  and drive our business forward.

 What Will Your Role Be 

As a Fullstack Engineer (f/m/d) in our Merchant Experience team, you’ll help build and evolve the digital products our partners and merchants interact with every day. You’ll work across the entire merchant journey — from the Partner Area, where designers manage their designs and shops, to the sign-up and publishing experience that turns an idea into a live SpreadShop, and the Merchant Area, where SpreadConnect merchants manage integrations with Shopify, TikTok, and other platforms. As a Fullstack Engineer (f/m/d), you’ll take ownership beyond individual UI components or API endpoints. You’ll design and implement features end-to-end, collaborate closely with product and design, and ensure that the experiences you build are reliable, performant, and easy to evolve. Your work directly impacts how merchants use and grow with our platform. You’ll build products that make their day-to-day work easier and help drive our business forward.

 What You´ll Do 


 Build and evolve merchant-facing product surfaces — sign-up and shop creation flows, shop management, design and product administration, sales statistics 
 Build the new publishing journey for shops — from sign-up to a live SpreadShop — and take drop-off out of every step 
 Own small to medium features end to end: design the UI, build theKotlin/Spring endpoints behind it, model the data, and ship both together 
 Extend our backend services where your features need it — new REST endpointsin the shop and partner services, data model changes with a proper migration, and integrations with external platforms such as Shopify or TikTok on the SpreadConnect side 
 Design and consume our REST and GraphQL APIs, and push back when a responseshape makes the frontend's life harder than it needs to be 
 Contribute to our cross-team frontend architecture work — shared components,hooks and API clients, and how we render, test and ship our apps 
 Keep merchant tooling fast — data-heavy tables, sales statistics and editorsare where perceived performance is won or lost 
 Take on larger topics — an epic, a new integration, a new merchant surface —and break them down into something the team can execute: slices, dependencies, open questions, and a first piece worth shipping 
 Work in an agile cross-functional team with a product owner, designers and backend engineers, and connect what you build to merchant activation and conversion 


 What You´ll Bring 


 Solid proficiency in TypeScript and React — component design, hooks, statemanagement, and the performance patterns that keep a growing app fast 
 Around three or more years of professional experience building web products, with a track record of features you carried from first ticket to production 
 Real CSS craft and experience working inside a design system or shared component library, not just against one 
 Experience consuming REST or GraphQL APIs and working with structured, data-heavy responses — product catalogs, variants and attributes bring more complexity than they first appear to 
 Working experience in a JVM backend — Kotlin or Java with Spring — and the ability to build a REST endpoint, model the data behind it and write the migration, not just read the code 
 A solid grasp of relational databases and SQL, and of what happens to a query when the table stops being small 
 Self-direction: you take an under-specified problem, find out what is actually needed, break it into deliverable pieces and drive them to donewithout waiting to be handed tickets 
 Testing as a habit rather than an afterthought, and a working relationship with code review 
 A keen eye for UI detail — you care about how something feels, not only whether it works 
 A product mindset: you ask who benefits from a change before you ask how to build it 
 Good communication skills in English 


 Why Should You Join Us 


 Autonomy and Impact: We believe in giving people real ownership. You'll have the freedom to make decisions, take action, and see the direct impact of your work on the business. 
 Development and Growth: We believe that the greatest professional and personal growth happens when you're challenged. If you're looking to build your career, you'll find plenty of opportunities to do so. 
 We Win as a Team: Work alongside ambitious, motivated colleagues who challenge and support each other to achieve exceptional results. Through honest feedback, high standards, and shared ambition, we bring out the best in one another. 
 Learn from Proven Entrepreneurs: Work closely with experienced founders and business leaders, gaining first-hand insights into growing a successful international company. 
 Transparency and Involvement: Stay connected to our vision through regular General Assemblies, learn about our processes in our production sites in the Czech Republic and join workshops and cross function initiatives to lead positive change. 
 The Extras That Matter: Enjoy 30 days of paid vacation, attractive employee discounts on our products and partner brands, modern office spaces designed for collaboration, and regular company events where we celebrate our successes together. 


 Equal Opportunity Employer 

We value diversity at Spread Group. We are proud of and continue to encourage the increasing diversity of our company culture and community. Your skills, talents, and experience are our focus no matter your age, ethnicity, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, marital or disability status.

About the company
Tomorrow University: A Next-Generation University for Impactful Careers
Education is the most powerful lever for driving the transition to a sustainable society. That’s why we’ve built a university dedicated to educating and empowering the change-makers of tomorrow. We offer accredited degree programs designed to equip learners with 21st-century competencies while providing access to a world-class network of experts to maximize their impact.
As a remote-first institution, we use technology and AI to enable flexible, personalized learning - accessible from anywhere in the world.
We are proud to be the first EdTech startup in Europe with a fully state-recognized university license and to be ranked among the Top 20 EdTech startups globally.
Our Inspiration
We believe that transforming education requires rethinking how we teach. At Tomorrow University, we move beyond the traditional, teacher-centered approach and embrace a student-centric learning model. Our goal is to equip learners with the essential skills and mindset needed to create global impact, supported by a vast network of change-makers.
Our Mission
At Tomorrow University, we leverage science and technology to enhance learning while fostering a global community for continuous growth and impact. Our students learn by applying their knowledge to real-world challenges and engaging with world-class educators, mentors, and partners from around the globe.
Be aware that all of our positions are completely Remote but our working hours are Central European Time (+/- 2h)
About the role
Tomorrow University is the university for those who want to build a more sustainable, equitable future. As part of our platform team, you’ll work with a group of engineers and product builders who care deeply about learning, impact, and collaboration.
We’re looking for a Full-Stack Engineer who lives in Berlin, ships end-to-end features with strong judgment, learns fast, and cares about educators and learners, including practical LLM features when they help the product.
Work model: Fully remote · CET (±2h) · Berlin residency required · Regular team onsites and Workations
About the role
You will work across our stack, from the Next.js frontend to backend services, APIs, and deployment workflows. You’ll join a small, cross-functional team that optimizes for ownership, trust, and high-quality collaboration over heavy processes.
In addition to shipping core product features, you will partner with product & learning design to ship features that improve the learning platform, sometimes with LLMs, always with clear UX, reliability, and human review where it matters.
We work remotely with regular opportunities to travel and meet as a team, balancing flexibility with strong collaboration rituals. You must live in Berlin; residency is required, while day-to-day work remains fully remote.
What you’ll do
Build and iterate on full-stack features for our learning platform, directly shaping how staff and learners use challenges, milestones, and AI-assisted workflows.
Develop and maintain our Next.js application and related frontend components.
Implement and improve backend services, APIs, and data flows using MongoDB.
When we use AI, help design simple, safe product loops — prompt  structured output  human review  save — pragmatic rather than research-heavy.
Collaborate with product, design, QA, engineering, and academic stakeholders in a low-ego environment that values trust, ownership, and clear communication.
Bring product sense into engineering discussions — question scope, propose simpler paths, and care about the user journey as much as the implementation.
What you bring
Experience shipping web product features end-to-end. Portfolio or side projects are welcome if your motivation and judgment are clear. We care more about ramp speed and ownership than a seniority label.
Comfortable with TypeScript and modern React; Next.js experience is preferred, but willingness to ramp fast matters more than years of Next.js experience.
Practical experience with MongoDB or similar NoSQL databases, or the clear ability to learn our data model quickly.
Curiosity about LLMs and good judgment around AI — prior experience shipping LLM features is a plus, not a gate.
A product mindset: you care about user experience, reliability, and impact, not just code or models.
Curiosity for education and working in a mission-driven environment — high energy for ToU’s mission beats a perfect CV.
Resident in Berlin, or relocating before your start date. Fully remote day-to-day. EU work authorization preferred.
Nice to have
Experience with AWS and serverless environments such as AWS Lambda.
Familiarity with structured LLM outputs, basic evals, or human-in-the-loop AI UX.
Background in edtech.
Interest in deployment, monitoring, and operational practices.
Experience collaborating closely with product and design in a small team.
German language skills are a nice-to-have, not required.
What Matters to Us
We care about people who take ownership, communicate clearly, learn quickly, and genuinely care about the people using what they build. We value pragmatism over perfection, collaboration over ego, and thoughtful product decisions over complexity for complexity’s sake.
Perks & Benefits
Work from anywhere, anytime
Our flexible work culture gives you the freedom to design your day. Your day-to-day work will be fully remote, while Berlin residency is required for this role. Need a change of scenery? We offer a co-working space budget so you can connect and collaborate wherever you are.
Grow with us
At Tomorrow University, we foster lifelong learning. You’ll have access to our innovative programs and be part of a culture that encourages continuous growth — personally and professionally.
Travel the world together
Twice a year, we bring the whole team together for a week-long Workation somewhere in Europe — think bonding, brainstorming, and big ideas in beautiful places.
Time to recharge
You’ll get 25 vacation days per year, plus public holidays based on your location.
Ready to shape the future of education and make an impact? Join us and help reimagine how we learn, grow, and build a better tomorrow.
At Tomorrow University, we believe in your potential — not your paperwork. Degrees are great, but your drive matters even more.
Compensation
As an international remote-first organisation, compensation is benchmarked against role level, experience, internal equity, and local market conditions in the candidate’s country of residence. The advertised range reflects the base salary for this role. Depending on the role and seniority level, additional compensation components, such as VSOPs, may also be offered.

job.title: Senior Frontend Developer
job.description:
Senior Frontend Developer – TypeScript, React & Design Sense
DATATRONiQ is a deep-tech startup from Germany for Industrial IoT and Edge AI. As Senior Frontend Developer you develop the dashboard our customers use to monitor production worldwide — from mid-market manufacturers to DAX corporations. You own our React and TypeScript stack; your code surfaces anomaly alerts and makes device management usable. Insights from our Edge AI land on screen so maintenance and quality teams can respond right away. Behind the dashboard runs our Go backend, all on Kubernetes. If you have a feel for good design and enjoy building demanding frontends — let's talk.
- Location
- Stuttgart, Ulm or Berlin
- Level
- Senior · 3+ years experience
- Stack
- TypeScript · React · Go (backend) · Kubernetes
About the role
Our platform ingests telemetry from sensors and controllers across modern production floors. Machine-learning models catch anomalies and quality patterns — often before production notices. The dashboard you help build turns signals into decisions: which process gets priority, which alert triggers a callout.
Your stack: TypeScript and React — sharpened by an eye for design, interaction, and performance. Our backend is Go. You work closely with the services that feed your frontend, read their code, and shape interfaces together. Everything runs on Kubernetes.
We work in a small, tightly coordinated team. Code reviews and pair programming are a fixed part of the week. Every Friday we share interesting finds from the web and new tools in our show-and-tell sessions. As a frontend developer you work daily with the backend team and the data scientists: your code is the interface where process data and AI predictions become visible for our users.
What are your responsibilities?
- You design and build our dashboard frontend (React, TypeScript) — from the first concept to production rollout on Kubernetes.
- You ensure frontend quality: tests, accessibility, and performance in real production use.
- You shape the design: interaction, visualization, and visual clarity are craft, not decoration.
- You turn Industrial IoT requirements into features that are intuitive to use and visually coherent.
- You shape technical decisions — library choices, tooling, CI pipelines, monitoring — and bring new development practices into the team.
What can you expect?
- Real end-to-end ownership of the dashboard: from the first concept of a new feature to rollout.
- The team decides on architecture, tooling, and test coverage.
- Agentic tooling in daily work: Codex, Claude Code, and new development practices — we try them early and use what works.
- Mostly on-site in Stuttgart, Ulm, or Berlin — Industrial IoT projects for customers worldwide, from mid-market manufacturers to DAX corporations.
Did we spark your interest?
This is a unique and exciting opportunity to work on a product that has the potential to make a significant impact in the industrial manufacturing sector. DATATRONiQ platform is built with TypeScript, Golang, Python, Scala, C++ and deployed as microservices on various Cloud environments and on-prem virtual machines using Kubernetes.
If you are passionate about using your skills to solve challenging problems and make a difference, we really would like to talk to you.
Get in touch with us at work@datatroniq.com. We are looking forward to your application!
